title: Expose the authenticated, limited import endpoint — docs/plans/ics-import/04-task-slices.md#t3
acceptance: Read the approved gates in docs/plans/ics-import/ and execute only packet T3 in docs/plans/ics-import/04-task-slices.md.
Outcome: Authorized callers can POST raw `text/calendar` bytes and receive the approved summary or stable safe error codes through the production router.
Scope: `backend/src/http.rs`, `backend/src/rate_limiter.rs`, HTTP and role cases in `backend/tests/ics_import.rs`

Changes: Mount and implement `POST /api/v1/calendars/:calendar_id/import-ics`; verify media type and non-empty body; call `IcsImportService`; map errors; emit content-free structured timing logs; classify the route as Standard write rate; add authenticated role, response-envelope, media-type, 1 MiB limit, and classifier tests.
Out of scope: service conversion rules, database schema, frontend behavior, application-state or router-builder signature expansion.

Acceptance: Owner, manager, and editor receive 201 for valid input; viewer, free/busy viewer, and unrelated caller receive non-enumerating 404; malformed and limit failures expose only their stable codes; incorrect media type and empty input are 400; oversized input is 413; the route is Standard-rate limited; logs contain no calendar content, UID, filename, title, description, or location.
Handoff: Final backend endpoint contract and complete integration-test evidence for the browser and E2E packets.
Record verification and completion in docs/plans/ics-import/00-status.md; preserve unrelated work.
